input.sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN a.account_type = '收入' THEN e.credit ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN a.account_type = '成本' THEN e.debit ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN a.account_type = '收入' THEN e.credit ELSE 0 END) AS v FROM fact_gl_entry e JOIN dim_account a ON e.account_id = a.account_id WHERE e.is_deleted = 0 AND e.currency = 'CNY' AND e.period LIKE '2025%'

events.text: 2025 年毛利率 38.79%，口径为（收入 − 成本）÷ 收入，仅含人民币未删除凭证。
